# Vendored SQLite amalgamation

- **Version:** 3.53.2
- **License:** Public domain (https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html)
- **Source:** amalgamation files as bundled by `libsqlite3-sys` 0.38.2
  (the same bundle the Rust build compiles), originally generated by the
  SQLite project from https://www.sqlite.org.
- **Files:** `sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, `sqlite3ext.h` — copied verbatim,
  no modifications.

## Why vendored

Murmur needs the SQLite **session extension** (`sqlite3session_*`), FTS5,
online backup, and scalar functions. No maintained Go SQLite driver exposes
the session API, so `internal/sqlite` binds this amalgamation directly with
cgo. This keeps Go-module dependencies at zero for the database engine and
matches the Rust build, which also compiles the amalgamation from source
(`rusqlite` with the `bundled` feature).

Compile flags used by `internal/sqlite` (mirroring the Rust feature set):

- `SQLITE_ENABLE_SESSION` — change capture (required)
- `SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5` — full-text search indexes
- `SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA` — column metadata
- `SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1` — serialized threading mode
- `SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0`? — no: memory diagnostics need memstatus on.

## Updating

1. Download a new amalgamation from https://www.sqlite.org/download.html.
2. Replace the three files.
3. Update the version above and re-run `go test ./internal/sqlite/`
   (especially the session round-trip tests).
